title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass Tool
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of the Spyglass tool, delivering a robust and polished experience to empower your workflows.

title: Enhanced File Management in Your Editor
summary: We've launched powerful new controls that empower you to effortlessly manage, customize, and display all your images and files directly within your editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our brand new roadmap page provides a transparent look at our completed features, upcoming developments, and exciting plans for the future of Noeko.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've significantly improved checkboxes, making them larger, easier to click, and fully draggable for a more intuitive and integrated experience across your tasks.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've refined our collaboration experience to make working with your team more intuitive and provide clearer insights into shared progress.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery and Collaboration
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, making teamwork and discovery more intuitive and integrated across your network.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're expanding Noeko to support a wide array of international languages, making it accessible and user-friendly for everyone around the world.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with full control, greater involvement, and complete transparency in the project's development.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge Map's Full Potential
summary: Transform your visual knowledge map into an active hub for discovery and collaboration with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities.

title: Advanced Search & Personalized Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your knowledge with advanced filters, smart sorting capabilities, and the power to save your customized views as personalized Compendiums.

title: Enhanced Content Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive and dynamic way to connect and interact with your content, allowing you to structure your notes and workflows more effectively.

title: Noeko's Grand Debut: Self-Host and Unlock Premium Power
summary: Prepare for the official launch of Noeko, complete with versatile self-hosting options and a suite of premium capabilities to elevate your work.

title: New and Improved Themes
summary: We are revamping our existing themes and introducing exciting new visual options to give you more ways to personalize your experience.

title: Smarter Welcome Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your homepage experience with dynamic welcome messages that always accurately reflect the current time of day, making your visit even more personalized.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Boost your productivity with new bulk actions that enable swift item removal from tags, direct deletion, and quick detail viewing, all from a unified tag list interface.

title: Connect All Your Content
summary: Effortlessly bring all your valuable information into the platform by connecting a variety of content sources, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, not just PDFs.
